title: Describe terminology licensing accurately and consistently
requirements:
- Distinguish international releases, authorised extensions and separately identified local additions
- Revise the licensing footnote to distinguish full SNOMED CT, the GPS and their access conditions accurately
- Name Regenstrief Institute wherever governing organisations of terminologies are listed
- Parallel the SNOMED CT licensing note with LOINC's open licence
- Explain how licensed terminologies such as SNOMED CT and LOINC fit the open-standards principle
- State that managed access does not transfer licence rights
- Broaden the glossary definition of SNOMED CT beyond EHR use
- Cite loinc.org and Regenstrief at first mention of LOINC
